calendar_feed.body: Add the two key periods of her cycle to your own calendar (Google, Apple…). The link updates itself with every new cycle.
calendar_feed.not_enough_data: Not enough data to predict her cycles yet. Add a period date to enable the calendar.

labels_hint.discreet: Neutral labels (🌙 Period A / ☀️ Period B) — nothing sensitive shows in your calendar.
labels_hint.explicit: Clear labels (PMS & Period / Fertile window) + a reminder the day before.

calendar_feed.google_help_toggle: How to add it to Google Calendar?
calendar_feed.google_help: On desktop: open Google Calendar → on the left, "Other calendars" → "+" → "From URL" → paste the link → "Add calendar".
calendar_feed.refresh_notice: Google and Apple refresh the calendar every 12–24 h — new dates don't appear instantly.
calendar_feed.regenerate_confirm: The old link will stop working immediately. You'll need to re-subscribe with the new link.
